title: Counting a finite set by the fibres of a map
statement: Let $A,B$ be sets, let $S\subseteq A$ and $T\subseteq B$ be finite subsets, and let $f:A\to B$ satisfy $f(S)\subseteq T$. Then $|S|=\sum_{t\in T}|\{s\in S:f(s)=t\}|$. Empty finite sets and empty fibres are allowed. Finite sets use [def-sfb-finite-infinite-set].
